k.Merge2.BaseTutorial.dialogue: I've unpacked my things, it's time to see Sofia! She’s been asking me to check out her art studio for ages, but I kept running out of time…
k.Merge2.BaseTutorial.dialogue_2: It’s weird though… why does everything around here look so… abandoned?
k.Merge2.BaseTutorial.dialogue_3: Lisa? What are you doing here?
k.Merge2.BaseTutorial.dialogue_4: Came to visit you, of course. Come on, show off your studio!
k.Merge2.BaseTutorial.dialogue_5: Oh… actually, I don’t have a studio anymore. Well, technically I do, but I’m about to sell it to a developer — Voss & Vale.
k.Merge2.BaseTutorial.dialogue_6: I just came to pick up a few things. Will you help me look? I’m a little scared to do it alone… it’s so dark in here.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_0.step1: Without those boards, the window lets in so much more light. Now tell me, what happened to the studio? Why did you suddenly decide to sell it?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_0.step2: After my charity exhibition failed, I… just stopped coming here. I couldn't bring myself to step inside.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_0.step3: The place fell into such disrepair. It feels like getting rid of it would be easier than trying to restore it.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_0.step4: But this studio was your passion project! Let's fix this window, and you'll see — it'll come back to life in new shades again!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_1.step1: Yeah, it really did come to life… though mostly in all the shades of dust we couldn't see before.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_1.step2: Dust is no big deal. Unlike these shabby walls — they're begging for a fresh coat of filler!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_1.step3: Lisa, I'm not sure it’s worth trying to fix anything…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_1.step4: Of course it is! We'll sort out these walls, and you'll tell me everything about that exhibition that made you give up on your dream.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_2.step1: Well… I decided to hold a charity exhibition with my works. I spent ages preparing for it, basically living in my studio around the clock.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_2.step2: The day before the event, I hung all the paintings on display stands in the town square. And that night, someone vandalized them…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_2.step3: Officer Marcus tried to track down who did it, but the investigation went nowhere…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_2.step4: That sounds absolutely awful. I'm sorry I wasn't in Gardenridge with you back then… But I'm here now, and I'm gonna help you however I can!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_3.step1: The walls have really refreshed the space! A few more… dozen little touches, and the studio will be as good as new. You won't have to sell it!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_3.step2: I don't know… maybe we should just grab my things and leave? Let the future owner deal with everything else…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_3.step3: Okay, let's be honest. What’s going on? Why are you so set on leaving this place and selling it? That’s a pretty big decision.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_3.step4: I know, and I'm still not sure about it, it’s just… While I was gone, the place got haunted!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_3.step5: You mean by the ghosts of those poor dried-up plants in the corner? Then it’s time to exorcise them!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_4.step1: There we go — one less ghost haunting this room. Soon the spirits from beyond will stop bothering you!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_4.step2: No, I'm serious! At night, there are rustling and grinding sounds from here! I heard them with my own eyes! I mean— saw them with my own ears…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_4.step3: I recently had insomnia and decided to visit the studio again. As soon as I reached the door, I heard chilling sounds from inside!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_4.step4: Hey, Sofia, don’t get so worked up. Your imagination’s probably just running wild. Let's just get back to cleaning, okay?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_5.step1: Hopefully your worries will leave along with these old pots. There are no ghosts in existen—
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_5.step2: Shh! Do you hear that? Those heavy footsteps! We've awakened the studio’s spirits!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_5.step3: Sofia? Lisa? Oh, so you're the ones making noise in here! I thought it might be burglars, so I came to check!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_5.step4: See? It’s Axel, not a ghost! I'm so glad you dropped by! Want to help us fix the shelves?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_6.step1: Lisa, you've only just arrived in Gardenridge and you're already stirring up all kinds of action!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_6.step2: Yep, I'm trying to help Sofia get rid of the ghosts… of the past, and bring her studio back to life.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_6.step3: I've been trying to get her to fix this place, but our dear Sofi kept brushing me off. Now that there are two of us, she won't stand a chance!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_6.step4: Ugh, fine, I give up. Let’s try to fix everything here. But if anything goes wrong, I'm dropping this whole idea on the spot!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_7.step1: No shelf has ever withstood my hammer! You could put an elephant on this one now — it’d hold.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_7.step2: I'm afraid an elephant might feel a bit cramped up there, but I don't doubt your skills. You've always had golden hands.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_7.step3: Yep, that’s why I’m the most eligible builder in all of Gardenridge. I can even put up a five-story gazebo in your yard — just say the word!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_7.step4: Ahem, maybe let’s focus on improving things inside the building for now… like removing the boards from the door, for example.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_8.step1: Brr… do you feel that? It’s like some otherworldly chill just swept through…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_8.step2: It’s just a draft sneaking in through the broken door. We'll fix it and get rid of that cold for good!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_9.step1: Your door is ready, ladies! It’ll survive about three hundred years of opening and closing. After that you might need to oil the hinges a bit.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_9.step2: Perfect, Axel! With you around, this studio’s makeover won't take long at all.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_9.step3: Yeah, thank you, guys. Maybe I really was worrying for no rea— Oh no! I definitely heard something scratching just now! Am I losing my mind?!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_9.step4: No, I heard it too… It sounded like it came from behind those boxes on the floor. We have to check it out!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_10.step1: All clear, no one here. Except… huh, there are some weird scratch marks on the floor. Sofia, did you adopt a stray tiger for your studio?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_10.step2: Not a tiger — a ghost! And I didn't adopt it, it moved in on its own!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_10.step3: Hmm, judging by these marks, there isn't just one ghost… looks like there are several.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_10.step4: Ghosts, huh? Then let’s go hunt them down. Now, let’s see if anyone’s hiding in this cabinet!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_11.step1: The cabinet only had a few empty chip bags and some bread crumbs. Looks like your ghosts were hungry.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_11.step2: What if… after the chips they decide to snack on us?!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_11.step3: Ghosts don't eat people. Besides, I'm still not convinced they even exist…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_11.step4: Then let’s look for ectoplasm or some other spooky clues and find out for sure! There’s gotta be something under those leaves on the floor!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_12.step1: No ectoplasm. Just something that looks like jam stains with bits of fur. Although… maybe that is what ectoplasm looks like?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_12.step2: I'm pretty sure none of us knows enough about ghosts to tell whether they're actually here or not.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_12.step3: Please, details like that won’t stop me! I'll get to the truth — just you watch!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_12.step4: I don't doubt you, Axel. And while you're hunting for the truth, could you replace the old floorboards?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_13.step1: This new floor could withstand a whole tap-dancing troupe, let alone a bunch of puny ghosts!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_13.step2: Hey, show some respect! What if you make them angry?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_13.step3: Oh! Something just hissed from behind that plant! The ghosts really are upset!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_13.step4: Or maybe they're just annoyed by that dried-up flower? Let’s get rid of it!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_14.step1: The ghosts really did go quiet! I guess even otherworldly beings have a sense of beauty!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_14.step2: No wonder they settled in an art studio. Maybe they want to see it transformed too!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_14.step3: So I shouldn't have been afraid of disturbing their peace with the renovation.…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_14.step4: If the ghosts enjoy renovations this much, then— wait, I've got it! But first, let’s replace this old table!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_15.step1: The new table is wonderful, Axel! But… what exactly did you come up with?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_15.step2: It’s simple — we’ll decorate the studio to win over our ghosts. And once they let their guard down, that’s when we'll catch them!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_15.step3: How exactly… I haven't figured out yet, but the plan is in development!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_15.step4: Then… let’s decorate the window with some string lights? I've wanted to do that for ages but kept putting it off…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_16.step1: Ah… with the string lights up, the studio is starting to feel cozy again. Maybe I really shouldn't sell it to Voss & Vale…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_16.step2: Wait, you were going to sell the studio? To those scoundrels?!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_16.step3: No one knows for sure if they’re villains or not. And besides… I thought I didn't have a choice…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_16.step4: Guys, instead of arguing, let’s focus on something nice — like putting up the decorations. And you can tell me all about Voss & Vale.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_17.step1: Decorating really is calming… Ahem, well, Voss & Vale showed up in town recently offering to buy up unprofitable properties.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_17.step2: After the recent flood, a lot of buildings were damaged, and their owners gladly accepted the offer and sold their places.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_17.step3: Yep. After that, Voss & Vale signs started popping up on every corner. Sprouting like mushrooms after the rain!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_17.step4: So that’s why the town has become so… well, like these shelves — empty and impersonal. I think it’s time we filled them up again!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_18.step1: This is wonderful! I can feel the studio’s soul coming back. If only the same could happen to Gardenridge…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_18.step2: You think the town has lost its soul?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_18.step3: I’m not sure if Voss & Vale are really to blame, but something in Gardenridge has changed. It feels like it’s losing its old charm…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_18.step4: Then let’s start by changing what we can. Let’s keep working on the studio!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_19.step1: I still can't believe Sofia wants to deal with Voss & Vale!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_19.step2: You think it’s that bad of an idea?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_19.step3: As bad as sticking your head into a T-rex’s mouth! Voss & Vale want to swallow Gardenridge whole — residents included, I'm sure of it!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_19.step4: You don't have any proof they're criminals. But we will definitely look like criminals if we leave that door without curtains!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_20.step1: Nice curtains, sure — but you can't use them to pull the truth over your eyes! Voss & Vale are playing their own game, and you know it!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_20.step2: Alright, Axel. Then what do you want me to do?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_20.step3: For starters — don't sell the studio to those scoundrels!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_20.step4: I say we convince Sofia not with words, but with action. Let’s bring the studio’s old coziness back — by decorating the entrance area!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_21.step1: I think the studio already looks better than it ever did before. It’s incredible!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_21.step2: Told you! No one would willingly give up a place this beautiful!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_21.step3: Unless they get evicted by ghosts… We still haven't solved that problem! And I'm not thrilled about sharing a space with them.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_21.step4: Leave that to me! I've already got an idea for how to catch them. I'll be gone for a bit — you two keep busy. Maybe lay down the rug!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_22.step1: Axel might have a future in interior design! The rug looks perfect on the floor!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_22.step2: I just hope he’s as good at catching ghosts as he is at decorating…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_22.step3: Do you really think they live into the studio?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_22.step4: I'm not sure… but someone’s definitely here. Oh, these thoughts make me nervous! I'll lay out my art supplies to calm down…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_23.step1: An artist’s tools appreciate harmony and kind treatment. Every brush has a name so they feel happy working wi—
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_23.step2: And I'm back! Fully equipped to catch ghosts of any shape and size! I got my hands on an enchanted mirror trap!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_23.step3: Enchanted? Where did you even find that?!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_23.step4: The mirror was in my attic. And the spell — in a magazine called “The Tamed Poltergeist.” It had detailed instructions on catching a ghost.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_23.step5: Don’t ask how I got the magazine, but… I read the spell and enchanted the mirror! Come on, we have to hang it up and get rid of those ghosts!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_24.step1: Alright, the mirror’s magic should start attracting… raccoons?! What the— where did they come from? And where are the ghosts?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_24.step2: I think they were attracted not by magic, but by the sunbeams on the floor from the mirror. And there were never any ghosts at all!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_24.step3: The raccoons must’ve snuck into the empty studio, made strange noises, and messed everything up! And when we showed up, they just hid!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_24.step4: No way! So those adorable fluffy little creatures are what terrified me this whole time? Then… what are we supposed to do about them now?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_24.step5: Axel will lure the raccoons back into the forest using my mirror and a few sunbeams, and we'll keep tidying up and set out the ceramics.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_25.step1: Oh, done with the pots already? I only just escaped the raccoons — they were so busy playing with the sunbeams they refused to let me leave!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_25.step2: I had to sacrifice my lunch to distract them — only then could I run out of the forest!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_25.step3: See? You handle raccoons just as well as ghosts!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_25.step4: Now, ready to help us again? We need to craft a paper basket for Sofia!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_26.step1: What a wonderful basket! Finally my sketches won't go flying all over the studio while I'm working!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_26.step2: Oh? Did I just hear that you're planning to keep creating in the studio after all?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_26.step3: Well… you and Axel worked so hard to help bring my dream back to life. After that, I just can't let you down!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_26.step4: I'm not selling the studio. No more self-pity, no more fear of failing again. Time to get it together! Though… I will need a stool for that.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_27.step1: I'm so glad you're not going through with Voss & Vale! I'm ready to build you a whole dozen stools if you need them!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_27.step2: Oh, you and Lisa have already done so much for me! I've realized there was only one ghost here all along — the ghost of my regrets and fears.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_27.step3: I hope we managed to banish it from your studio?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_27.step4: Even better. You banished it from my heart — I feel the desire to create again! I need an easel, urgently!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_28.step1: Sofia, this is wonderful! Gardenridge looks like it’s glowing on your canvas!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_28.step2: I tried to give back the soul it’s been losing… I just hope it returns to the real town someday too.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_28.step3: You know… we managed to bring the studio’s soul back. Maybe we can do the same for Gardenridge? There are so many neglected buildings…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_28.step4: We could try restoring them before Voss & Vale buy everything out! I've only just found my home again — I don't want to lose it.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_28.step5: Lisa, that’s a great idea! And I already know where we should start… Come on, I’m sure you’ll be impressed by what’s left of the playroom.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_29.step1: The boards almost fell apart in my hands while I was carrying them! Even the junk in this playroom is in terrible shape!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_29.step2: Exactly why we need to get rid of it as soon as possible!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_29.step3: So get a grip — and use those hands to grab the boxes. No time to rest!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_30.step1: All done, boss! Hey, what are you staring at so intently?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_30.step2: At that empty frame on the wall. Remember how it used to hold the arcade high-score board?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_30.step3: Of course I do! I was the champion! No one could beat my score in Pixel Muncher!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_30.step4: But you could never beat me in Cosmic Blaster! Too bad there’s nothing left of the board now… And that dusty old frame really needs to go.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_31.step1: There we go — the frame’s gone where it belongs! Off to the sidelines of old memories, making room for new ones!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_31.step2: It really does feel more spacious without it. Which makes something else stand out a lot more now.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_31.step3: You mean that massive graffiti? Looks like some bored teens had their fun. And you know — there’s potential in it.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_31.step4: Oh yeah. And there’s also plenty of potential in sponges and cleaning solution. And they'll help us wash that graffiti right off the wall!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_32.step1: For defeating the wall monster, Axel and Lisa earn two hundred points each! Great job!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_32.step2: Ha! I know how we can boost our score. If we pry the boards off that boarded-up window, we can score a thousand each!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_33.step1: And just like that, we're back on top of the playroom leaderboard with our sco—
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_33.step2: Everyone stay where you are. We've received a report about a disturbance of public order and unlawful entry…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_33.step3: Axel and… Lisa?! What are you doing here?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_33.step4: Oh, hi, Markus. We're just cleaning up the playroom. We were actually about to throw out an old machine…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_34.step1: So you’re clearing out the junk in here?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_34.step2: Yep! We want to give kids a place where they can hang out together again.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_34.step3: That’s a good cause. Ever since the playroom closed, teens have been roaming the streets — and my district’s petty crime stats went up.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_34.step4: So we're here to save our dear officer a few headaches! And we'll be done in no time — just like fixing that hole in the ceiling!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_35.step1: What you're doing is good for public order, but… it’s still illegal. You're working here without the building owner’s permission.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_35.step2: I got an anonymous tip about someone breaking into the playroom and making a racket. One more call like that, and I'll have to take you in.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_35.step3: Oh… we didn't really think that through. So what do we do now? Do we really have to leave everything like this?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_35.step4: No… I’ll try to get hold of the owner and make this official. Meanwhile, keep at it — that ladder in the corner looks ready for the trash!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_36.step1: Hey, doesn't this whole complaint thing feel a bit suspicious to you? We barely started fixing up the playroom, and suddenly there’s a report!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_36.step2: Maybe one of the neighbors thought some troublemakers broke in and decided to call the police?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_36.step3: I don't know… to me, this smells more like someone’s corporate interests than simple neighborhood vigilance.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_36.step4: You mean Voss&Vale? I think I know how we can find out for sure. You take care of the walls for now!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_37.step1: All set — the walls look brand new! Alright, Lisa, spill it. What’s this plan of yours?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_37.step2: I found an ad for a private investigator in the paper recently. If Voss & Vale are behind the complaint, we'll need evidence to prove it.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_37.step3: So you want to call in a detective to crawl around with a magnifying glass and sniff out those scoundrels’ tracks?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_37.step4: Already did! Everyone should stick to what they do best. The detective investigates — and we get back to fixing the floor!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_38.step1: The high-strength concrete floor is ready to withstand an invasion of sneakers in every shape and size!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_38.step2: So when is that detective finally showing up to start the investigation?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_38.step3: All in good time, Axel. We've got plenty to do even without a detective. It’s time to set up the arcade machines!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_39.step1: Man, my hands are itching to fire these up! Maybe we could play a couple of rounds while we wait for the detective?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_39.step2: I'm afraid you'll have to put that idea on hold. Good afternoon.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_39.step3: I've got the gist of your situation, so first I'll need to take a look around, if you don't mind.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_39.step4: Of course, Detective! Do what you need to do — we'll keep arranging the furniture. This room could really use a couch!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_40.step1: I wouldn't say no to a couch like that either! Cozy and soft… unlike the detective. He seems like a pretty tough cookie.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_40.step2: Wait, did you just compare the detective to a couch?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_40.step3: Uh— I'm just thinking about the investigation, okay! I wonder if our detective will find any traces of Voss&Vale?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_40.step4: Axel, relax and let him do his job. We need to distract you with something… Oh! Lay a rug on the floor!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_41.step1: I see you’ve already made quite a bit of progress here… Pity I didn't get to see the playroom in its original state.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_41.step2: Oh no, I hope we didn't destroy any important evidence?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_41.step3: We'll never know. Still, I found something — someone was watching the building from the nearby park. I found binoculars in the bushes.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_41.step4: That’s incredible! Could you show them to us? Though it’s a bit dark in here to examine them properly. Let’s set up a floor lamp first.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_42.step1: Whoa, with proper lighting you can tell these binoculars are professional-grade! Just like something out of a spy movie!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_42.step2: Yes, they're definitely not ordinary. You wouldn't find binoculars like these in a charity shop.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_42.step3: Still, it’s too early to draw any conclusions. I need to keep searching and inspect the building further.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_42.step4: Alright. If you need our help, you'll find us here. We'll be putting a pouf in the playroom.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_43.step1: Phew, done. I can't believe someone was watching us. Who would even need that?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_43.step2: You don't need a crystal ball to see it! This has Voss&Vale written all over it — I'm sure of it!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_43.step3: Brr… what if they're still watching us right now? I suddenly feel really uneasy. I kind of want to get out of here as fast as possible…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_43.step4: Hey, don't lose heart, Lisa! I know exactly how to chase those thoughts away. It’s time to fire up the arcade machines!

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_44.step2: Alright, I admit it — you're a true champion. So, did the taste of victory help chase those worries away?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_44.step3: Even more than that — it lit a fire in me! Now I want to perfect this playroom just to spite all the naysayers!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_44.step4: Now that’s the spirit! Let’s go, fighter — time to put your plan into action. Let’s hang up some posters!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_45.step1: These posters make me feel like a kid again — all set to ditch homework and hang out at the arcade with friends all night!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_45.step2: Oh, I know what’ll take you even further back. Neon signs on the wall!

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_46.step2: In the boxes by the exit. They were in great condition, so I figured they should go back where they belong.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_46.step3: I've finished my inspection, folks. And I should mention — those boxes contain quite a few interesting items. For example, a brand-new TV.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_46.step4: Could you plug it in? I think it’s worth taking a closer look.

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_47.step2: Maybe the owner brought it in? Planning to install it after the renovation, but then abandoned the idea?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_47.step3: Possible. But I also found some documents that need a closer look. I'll need a small table to lay them out.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_48.step1: Interesting papers. A renovation estimate, various receipts and lists… All with recent dates, but no names or organizations mentioned.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_48.step2: I also found signs of recent tampering with the electrical panels, along with several markings on the outside of the building.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_48.step3: I don't understand — what does all of this mean?

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_48.step5: Yeah, and we're not backing off! I'll get the lighting sorted right now. We'll finish this renovation, no matter whose plans we’re wrecking!

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_49.step2: I know who you mean — but all the evidence is circumstantial. We can't move against Voss&Vale legally…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_49.step3: Still, I won't stop digging. This is where my authority ends — but if you see anything suspicious again…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_49.step4: We'll definitely let you know. Thanks for your help, Detective. And we'll keep working — there are still some pillows to put out…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_50.step1: I can't believe Voss&Vale are going to get away with this! It’s obviously all their doing!

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_50.step3: You know what — while we wait for Markus to bring word on the renovation permit, let’s hook up the console.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_50.step4: Just don't expect to beat me as easily as you did in Cosmic Blaster! Come on — time to grab the controllers!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_51.step1: Having fun, kids? I see you’ve already finished renovating the playroom — impressive.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_51.step2: Markus! So, did you manage to get everything officially approved?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_51.step3: You bet. The owner was more than happy to hear you took on the playroom as a volunteer project.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_51.step4: What’s more — if you're up for continuing to restore Gardenridge… I've got another place for you.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_51.step5: Of course we are! What kind of place?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_51.step6: A veterinary clinic. Something unpleasant happened there, and it had to close down… but now it’s up for restoration. Interested?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_51.step7: We're already on our way at full speed, Markus! Thanks for the lead!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_52.step1: There we go — much better without the draft. Axel, do you know what actually happened here? Was it the flood again?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_52.step2: Not just that. Don’t you remember? When we were kids, there was a big scandal at this clinic. What kind, though… honestly, no idea.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_52.step3: Hmm, yeah, that does ring a bell… Oh well, whatever happened in the past doesn’t matter. What matters is the future!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_52.step4: And I can already predict it — in the very near future, we’ll restore all the plaster on that wall!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_53.step1: Wow, what a difference! With the walls all fixed up, it already feels so much nicer in here!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_53.step3: Bob, my man, long time no see! Decided to join our renovation crew? No problem — we’re always open!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_53.step4: Axel’s right. If you’re up for it, you could help us hang the lamp. You’ll handle the wiring way better than we will!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_54.step1: Great job, Bob! You’ve always been good with tech. We’re lucky you showed up.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_54.step2: I was just passing by and saw you and Markus. Figured I’d stop in.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_54.step3: That’s the right call! Now you get to pitch in and help restore Gardenridge too!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_54.step4: Yeah, I’d like that. I’ll help you fix the cabinets.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_55.step1: Bob, with you around, things are definitely moving faster! Though at first, I honestly thought this place was completely hopeless…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_55.step2: By the way, do you know what actually happened to the clinic? Care to tell us?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_55.step3: Uh, well… how about we remove that old board from the wall first?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_56.step1: The cork board’s gone. But don’t think we’re giving up on getting that story out of you — you clearly know something.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_56.step2: Alright, it’s just… I don’t remember all the details. Basically, one night all the animals escaped from the clinic’s inpatient ward.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_56.step3: It caused a huge scandal. All the animals were found, but the clinic’s reputation took a hit. It had to shut down.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_56.step4: Well, that explains why the couch looks like a hundred clawed paws ran across it. Let’s see if we can make it look presentable again…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_57.step1: Perfect — the couch is good as new! But your story about the clinic, Bob… it’s really sad. How did the animals even manage to escape?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_57.step3: Okay, let’s stop poking at the past. It’s old and nasty — just like that plant in the corner! Time to get rid of it and forget about it.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_58.step1: Brr, when I grabbed the pot, a bunch of bugs came crawling out at me. Good thing we tossed that dried-up disaster!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_58.step2: Hey, you’re still afraid of insects? Just like when we were kids?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_58.step3: I’m not afraid of them! It just caught me off guard… and anyway, no time to chat! Bob and I still have a whole pile of boxes to carry out!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_59.step1: That’s all the boxes. What’s next?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_59.step2: Oh, Bob, you work so fast I can barely keep up with coming up with tasks…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_59.step3: Don’t worry, Lisa — I’ve got tasks covered. While we were hauling boxes, I tripped at least ten times!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_59.step4: So now it’s time to give this floor a proper beating with a hammer and nails — and get rid of every hole and dent!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_60.step1: And that’s it — not a single crack left in the floor! Now we can—
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_60.step2: Achoo! Oh, sorry, I think I’ve got… A-a-choo! My allergies are acting up…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_60.step3: Looks like all our activity stirred up pollen from those dried-up flowers. Let’s get rid of them real quick!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_61.step1: How is it now? Bob, can you breathe a bit easier?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_61.step2: Yeah, thanks. I’m ready to keep going. What’s next?

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_62.step3: I’d say… we should install the X-ray machine.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_63.step1: Excellent work! With high-quality equipment like this, the clinic will quickly earn a great reputation with its visitors!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_63.step3: Then let’s keep going — we still have plenty of equipment to set up!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_64.step1: Wow, look at all this high-tech gear! We could open the clinic right now!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_64.step2: Not yet. We’re missing a proper examination table.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_64.step3: Right! How did I forget that? Let’s set it up right now!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_65.step1: I’ve set up a special mechanism in the table so it’s more comfortable for vets to examine pets.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_65.step2: You’re a great mechanic! But the way you care about the comfort of both staff and animals… ever thought about becoming a vet instead?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_65.step3: I have… allergies to animals. Being a vet wouldn’t work for me…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_65.step4: Axel, don’t push it. That might be a sensitive topic for Bob. Better hang up the information boards on the wall!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_66.step1: All the boards are up… and hey, I honestly didn’t mean to offend good old Bob! I was just asking about vet stuff, nothing more…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_66.step2: Actually, there’s another reason why I can’t be a vet — shame. I think it’s long past time I confessed everything…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_66.step3: If there’s something you want to share, Axel and I are always ready to listen.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_66.step4: Thank you. I think I’ll sit down first. Oh—and could I get a cushion? When I’m nervous, I always need to hold something soft.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_67.step1: Well… the truth is, the clinic closed because of me.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_67.step2: How could that be? You were just a kid back then!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_67.step3: I loved animals despite my allergies. But I was scared of doctors as a kid, so I thought the animals here were being… mistreated.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_67.step4: I once hid behind the plant in the corner… Actually, it looked nice there. Maybe we should put a new one in its place?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_68.step1: See how the plant covers the corner? No one noticed me, so the staff calmly went home and closed the clinic for the night.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_68.step2: I came out of hiding, opened the doors from inside, and let all the animals go. I thought I was doing the right thing — saving them.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_68.step3: Oh, Bob… you were just a little boy who thought he was doing the right thing. Don’t blame yourself…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_68.step4: Let’s lay a rug on the floor for now, okay? Take a break from the story and try to calm down a bit.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_69.step1: There used to be a rug just like this right here. Visitors admired it. Then the clinic shut down. All because of me.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_69.step2: So when I saw you renovating the place… I knew I had to help however I could, to make up for what I did.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_69.step3: What matters isn’t what happened back then. It’s what you’re doing now. And right now, you’re trying to set things right, buddy!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_69.step4: Thanks to you, the clinic will bloom again like— actually, hold on, I’ll add some flowers to illustrate!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_70.step1: Here you go — it’s a hypoallergenic variety my grandmother grew herself. So your allergy won’t act up!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_70.step2: Thanks. I took my allergy meds anyway, because… Actually, I recently found a stray kitten near the clinic.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_70.step3: I couldn’t take him home because of my allergies, so I just fed him. But maybe we could give him a home here? What do you think?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_70.step4: That’s a wonderful idea! Then we should get some treats ready for our fluffy friend!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_71.step1: Huh, not a single cat in sight. Maybe we picked food he doesn’t like?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_71.step2: I tried bringing Ginger into the clinic, but he hissed right at the door, jumped out of my arms, and ran off into the bushes.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_71.step3: Ginger? That’s a very telling name… Maybe he just got scared by something?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_71.step4: Yeah, Bob, could you check the building for any scary noises or anything like that? Axel and I will hang up the visitor log in the meantime.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_72.step1: Alright, the log is up — but Bob’s still not back. Think the ghosts from Sofia’s studio moved in here, and now he’s hunting them?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_72.step2: I doubt it — he’s probably just checking everything carefully. Since he’s not back yet, let’s install the info display on the partition.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_73.step1: Well, the display’s in place — and so is Bob! We were starting to think we’d lost you. Did you figure out what scared the cat?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_73.step2: At first everything seemed fine. But then I found a strange device near the drainage pipe. I tried to figure out what it was.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_73.step3: A device? Huh. And what did it turn out to be?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_73.step4: An ultrasonic repeller. Animals find the sound unpleasant, so they try to stay away from it.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_73.step5: That explains why Ginger wouldn’t go inside! Bob, please get rid of that thing quickly, and we’ll prepare a carrier for the kitty.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_74.step1: Ginger finally has a cozy hideout. The repeller is gone, so there’s nothing to be afraid of anymore. But where did that device even come from?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_74.step2: Looks like someone is trying to sabotage our restoration work again. If we hadn’t found that repeller in time…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_74.step3: The clinic would have reopened… but the animals wouldn’t enter. No patients means it’d close again.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_74.step4: And Voss&Vale would’ve been able to buy the building… Well, not anymore! Ginger will prove it — it’s time to invite him back inside!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_75.step1: This is wonderful! Bob, thanks to you, the clinic is starting a new life — and the kitten has found a home!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_75.step2: Until the staff arrives, I’ll keep coming by to take care of Ginger. And even after that… I’ll keep visiting him, of course.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_75.step3: You did great, Bob. I’ll come by too whenever I get a break from all the renova—

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_75.step7: Markus mentioned you’ve been fixing places around town as volunteers… so I thought, why not hop in with me and take a ride to the garden?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_75.step8: If it means helping the city — we’re in!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_76.step1: Nice work, Axel! The future flowers in the greenhouse will need plenty of light, so fixing up the windows was the right place to start.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_76.step2: Plenty of light, huh… Then let’s take care of the glass dome next — even the brightest sunbeams won't make it through all that grime!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_77.step1: You're doing a great job, guys! I couldn't even manage half of what you’ve already done here on my own!

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_77.step4: I cleaned up some trash, dealt with the water, and put buckets under the leaks… And hey, speaking of buckets — maybe it’s time this one retired.

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_78.step2: Or you can keep up the water treatments and soak the other leg too! Because now we're going to wash the dirt off the ceiling!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_79.step1: Look, Lisa — the ceiling’s sparkling now! And I didn’t even get myself wet!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_79.step2: Don't get your hopes up too high. We still need to clean the walls of old wallpaper and graffiti. The threat of wet pants isn’t over yet!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_80.step1: Phew, I didn't realize scrubbing walls with a sponge counts as a workout. I'm actually a bit tired…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_80.step2: Hey, Tony, how about you handle the planting instead? I could really use a break.

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_81.step1: Ouch! While I was fixing the floor, I tripped hard over those boxes by the wall! What’s in them, dumbbells?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_81.step2: No, those are the fertilizers I used. They're about the only thing that survived the flood in the greenhouse.

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_81.step4: My grandmother had the exact same packaging for pest control products. I think we'd better get rid of these boxes.

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_82.step2: I have a feeling someone wanted exactly that to happen. They left those boxes here on purpose, with fake labels…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_82.step3: If someone tried to restore the place, it'd make sense to use the local “fertilizer” — after all, the greenhouse used to bloom with it.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_82.step4: I'd put money on Voss&Vale! They messed with this place too — I'm furious! Ugh, I'm going to toss out that chair. I need to blow off some steam!

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_83.step2: I don't think so. No one’s been coming here for a long time — why would anyone want a half-ruined building?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_83.step3: Looks like someone did. While I was dealing with the chair, I noticed footprints other than ours.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_83.step4: They could be anyone’s. It’s not like the footprints say Voss&Vale. Let’s finish the cleanup — the old boards still need to go.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_84.step1: Ha! I just took a closer look at the building and found the exact same markings the detective showed us back in the playroom!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_84.step2: Alright, that looks a lot more like solid evidence. So Voss&Vale really were trying to get their hands on the greenhouse too…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_84.step3: Yeah, well, we've ruined their nasty plans again! They have no idea who they're messing with!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_84.step4: Then let’s keep restoring the greenhouse! It’s time for some furniture — I think a small commode would fit in perfectly here.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_85.step1: Looks solid. Just like our confidence in taking on Voss&Vale!

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_85.step3: I've talked to their drivers at a gas station a couple of times — nasty bunch. They shut down any questions about their company real fast.

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_87.step1: Oh man, that bench is practically calling my name — perfect place to flop down and rest after a long day!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_87.step2: So what’s stopping you from answering the call? You deserve a little rest more than anyone — you’ve been such a huge help…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_87.step3: Lisa, for you I'd do anything! I mean — for Gardenridge too… uh, anyway, I'll rest later. What’s next on the plan?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_87.step4: Alright then, Axel — if you're still full of energy… let’s add a chair in the corner. More seating wouldn't hurt!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_88.step1: Wow! The greenhouse already looks way better than it did before! I mean, if you imagine it filled with flowers, of course…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_88.step2: No need to imagine — it’s time for this place to bloom again!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_88.step3: And we'll have help from the best plant expert there is… Let’s get ready for her arrival and start placing the first flowers!

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_89.step2: Gloria?! So that's our gardening expert! How did I not realize that right away?

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_89.step4: First, let’s bring in a watering can — flowers love being cared for right on time!

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_90.step2: Sorry, but I'll have to skip this lesson. My break’s run long — time to get back on the road and drive passengers around Gardenridge!

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_91.step1: Thanks for the great drink! And for fixing up the greenhouse — it’s clear it’ll be better soon. I've got to get back behind the wheel!

k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_92.step1: Wow, Grandma, you're an amazing designer! Mmm… and what a scent. How do you manage to grow flowers that are so fresh and beautiful?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_92.step2: Just a little care, a pinch of tenderness… and even the weakest sprout will straighten up and turn into a lovely flower!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_92.step3: I picked up a pretty scraggly plant not long ago, and now it looks amazing. Let’s set it by the wall — that spot suits it best.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_93.step1: Well, would you look at that, Gloria! Thanks to you, the greenhouse has turned into a real magical garden!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_93.step2: Thank you, dear, but it’s still missing the most important thing. And we won't manage without your strong shoulder.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_93.step3: Right in the center, we'll plant… a lemon tree! It will become the greenhouse’s main feature. Come along, Axel — I know where to find a sapling.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_94.step1: Gloria, when you said it would be a “sapling,” I imagined something… a bit smaller.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_94.step2: It just grew a little bigger thanks to my fertilizer. But now it’s a true symbol of sunshine and the beginning of a new life for the greenhouse!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_94.step3: Oh! I just noticed a kitty watching us through the window! Looks like he wants to admire our tree too. Shall we let him inside?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_95.step1: What a cutie! I think he likes how we've transformed the greenhouse. Look at him — he’s admiring the flowers so intently!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_95.step2: And he’s not alone. This place is unbelievable. I've never seen anything so beautiful… well, as far as buildings go!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_95.step3: Still, we're missing one final touch. Let’s add a drop of true magic… and release fluttering butterflies into our garden!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_96.step1: It’s so beautiful! Grandma, thank you for helping us bring the greenhouse back to life!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_96.step2: My dear, you know you can always count on me! Besides, I'm happy to do my part in restoring Gardenridge.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_96.step3: You're still here! I didn't even recognize the greenhouse from afar — it’s changed that much… Oh! That’s not why I came!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_96.step4: Lisa, Gloria, you need to get back to the café right away — there’s been a real disaster! The café… it’s destroyed!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_97.step1: There we go — that’s a start! See, Grandma? We'll clean everything up, fix it all, and the café will be good as new!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_97.step2: I don’t know, dear… Maybe it’s time to accept it. To let the café go and stop clinging to memories…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_97.step3: Whew, I barely caught up with you — you rushed off so fast! I've already heard everything, and I'm ready to get to work!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_97.step4: Axel, I knew I could count on you! Help us throw out the damaged furniture — I'm afraid it just won't fit into the café’s future look anymore.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_98.step1: It’s still hard to believe. In just a few hours, a simple accident destroyed the café — and it happened while we were away…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_98.step2: Markus, could you tell us more about what happened? I’d like to look over the documents — I can't shake the feeling that something’s off.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_98.step3: By law, I can't share certain details, but… as an exception, and out of respect for Gloria, I'll prepare the documents for you.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_98.step4: Thank you — that means a lot to us. And for now… we'll keep working on the repairs.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_99.step1: All done! Your humble servant has mercilessly dealt with all those broken planks the furniture turned into!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_99.step2: Ah, those so-called planks… Your grandfather Richard and I chose that furniture together. And now, it really does belong at the dump.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_99.step3: But it’s a chance to freshen up the interior, right? Change can be a reason to make life better!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_99.step4: You know, dear… I've been holding onto things too much. Memories live in the heart, not in objects. Well… the flower pots should go as well.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_100.step1: Oh no, I think I spilled some soil from the flower pots all over myself… Lisa, do you happen to have a couple of wet wipes?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_100.step2: Nope, but don't worry — we'll clean you up anyway. We're about to wash the walls, so we can give your outfit a nice wet cleanup too!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_101.step1: Ouch! Lisa, did you just hit me? Do you think I cleaned the walls that badly?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_101.step2: No, the walls are sparkling clean! And I’m not hitting you — that was a chunk of plaster falling from the ceiling!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_101.step3: Yeah, the ceiling’s definitely seen better days. Alright, I'll fix it real quick before something worse drops on our heads.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_102.step1: Oh, Lisa! You and Axel truly have golden hands! I look around and it’s as if the accident never happened. It makes my heart so happy!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_102.step2: Ahem… almost. The only reminders of the disaster are the shattered window panes and the drafts whistling through those gaping holes…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_102.step3: That’s no problem at all. We'll just replace the glass — and the wind won't dare wander in uninvited anymore. The windows will be good as new!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_103.step1: You know, while I was fixing the windows, I came up with one big idea. Though… it’s going to need a lot of tools.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_103.step2: And the tools on the table won't work for your big idea?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_103.step3: They got soaked and gave up on life… I know — I'll swing by my place to grab my tools and toss these on the way.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_104.step1: So, Axel, are you finally going to share your big idea? Grandma and I are dying of curiosity!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_104.step2: I propose… a glass dome in the ceiling! We could even add some decorative molding… and the café would get so much more light!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_104.step3: It sounds nice, but I'm not sure Grandma will agree to such a big change…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_104.step4: Axel’s idea is simply wonderful, dear! Lately I've felt the café’s been a bit too dark, so a glass dome would be just perfect!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_105.step1: Amazing — it’s so beautiful! The sunlight pours through the dome, making everything feel brighter and more spacious. It truly warms my heart!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_105.step2: You're right, Axel — your idea really was amazing! How did you even come up with it?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_105.step3: The greenhouse gave me the inspiration. But that’s not where my good ideas end! Sunlight is great, of course…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_105.step4: But the sun tends to set in the evening, so the café will need proper lighting. I'll go hang up the lamps!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_106.step1: Oh, Lisa, I heard about what happened and ran here right away! Is there anything I can do to help?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_106.step2: I'm so glad you came! Grandma’s pretty shaken after the accident, so she could really use some support while we handle the repairs.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_106.step3: "Of course! I'll stay with Gloria and keep her spirits up. And I brought a couple of my paintings — maybe you can use them for decoration?"
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_106.step4: They’ll be perfect! The old paintings were ruined in the flood — I'll replace them with your masterpieces right away!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_107.step1: Sofia really is an incredible artist! Axel, look — the café has come alive with new colors thanks to her paintings!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_107.step2: Yeah, our dear old Sofi is a true master. Just looking at her art got me feeling inspired myself!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_107.step3: Oh? And what exactly did that inspiration inspire you to do?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_107.step4: That it’s time to set up the couches! Future café guests probably won't be thrilled about sitting on the floor!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_108.step1: Hello, Lisa. I was at the precinct and heard about the accident. I got the case documents from Marcus on your behalf. I hope you don't mind...
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_108.step2: Not at all — I'm glad you're on it! The incident at the café felt suspicious… did you find anything unusual in the paperwork?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_108.step3: The contractor responsible for the accident is is connected to Voss&Vale. I suspect they're involved — I just need to dig deeper.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_108.step4: I knew something was off! Please keep looking into the documents, and I'll get back to the repairs — we need to set up a dessert display case.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_109.step1: Your desserts are dangerously tempting. Even I got distracted — but I still found inconsistencies in the files.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_109.step2: The emergency repairs were rushed and done without notifying the café owners. That alone makes them illegal.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_109.step3: Looks like Voss&Vale really wanted to rush everything while we were away. Those scoundrels!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_109.step4: Their contractor has come up in other cases involving accidents during emergency repairs around the city. I'm going to examine them closely.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_109.step5: I doubt I'll be much help with the investigation, so I'll wait for your results. Meanwhile, I still need to set up the tables…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_110.step1: Phew, now the guests will finally have somewhere to sit. Just a little more, and the café will be back in business!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_110.step2: Lisa, I came to help too. I figured the coffee machine must've been damaged in the flood, so I brought a new one.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_110.step3: I've upgraded it a bit… now the coffee will always come out perfect.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_110.step4: I can't wait to try it! Let’s get the coffee machine set up where it belongs!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_111.step1: Mmm, the coffee smells and tastes incredible! I don't know what you did to the machine, but I'm sure this is a whole new word in technology!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_111.step2: You're flattering me. I just… tweaked the settings a little.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_111.step3: Ahem, I've got another call to get to. Is there anything else I can help with?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_111.step4: Don’t worry, buddy — we're down to the finishing touches. I can handle hanging the shelves for coffee beans and spices myself!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_112.step1: All set! These shelves would survive ten floods and still stay put — I guarantee it!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_112.step2: Let’s hope we won't have to test that. I'll take your word for it! May the café delight its guests without any more accidents!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_112.step3: Oh, my dears, you've done the impossible! Our family café is back on its feet — all thanks to you. I had almost given up…
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_112.step4: Now I see I was too quick to lose hope. You know what — it’s time I did my part in restoring the café too! I want to decorate it with flowers!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_113.step1: Grandma, it’s beautiful! I hope the renewed café will make you just as happy as the old one did!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_113.step2: Of course, dear — just like you said: Change can be a reason to make life better!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_113.step3: And I'm going to start making my life better right now. But first… I'll bring some fresh fruit for our future guests!
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_114.step1: I see you've finished restoring the café. In that case, I suggest you head to another location, Lisa.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_114.step2: And where would that be? Is this connected to the investigation? Are we going to take on Voss&Vale?
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_114.step3: Not yet. The evidence isn't strong enough. But I traced their next target — their contractors are circling the museum.
k.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_114.step4: These scoundrels are targeting the museum? Are they trying to wipe out Gardenridge’s history next? We can't let that happen, Lisa — let’s go!
